comments.text: Possible loading/unloading bay (laad- en losplaats) here that is not mapped. The Dutch BGT (large-scale topography) lists a small "parkeervlak" at this spot, but a user who looked at the place reports it is a loading bay, not regular parking. Could someone with local knowledge or street-level imagery of their own (survey/Mapillary) check it? If confirmed, suggested tagging: an area with amenity=parking_space + parking_space=delivery (and access=delivery or the signed restriction). Reported via gratisparkeren.com, which uses these tags to avoid suggesting loading bays as free parking.
